name: Katagiri Mizu
source:
The representative of the main character's class.
Perhaps due to her position, she often helps out Mai, who has just transferred.
She often talks with the protagonist ever since he saved her during first grade.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160401085609/http://www.sakuramint.net/tsugiteras/tsugi_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
